decisions.reason: Upgrading the MeetAlfred subscription does not change the requirement to preserve the existing integration and ongoing campaign.
The Pro-plan decision does not change the specified Zap-based synchronization method or the requirement's deferred lifecycle.
The source changes the MeetAlfred subscription tier, not the requirements or scope of Zapier account configuration.
The subscription upgrade does not alter the email channel, automation mode, MeetAlfred platform choice, or deferred lifecycle.
The source does not change the LinkedIn campaign's channel, automation behavior, or platform selection.
The Pro-plan selection does not change the required silent-lead workflow or its no-manual-cleanup constraint.
The upgraded subscription is for MeetAlfred; it does not replace or modify the HubSpot Starter plan.
The MeetAlfred Pro decision does not resolve or change the separate Sales Navigator Advanced versus Advance Plus plan conflict.
MeetAlfred subscription selection does not alter the requirement to create a campaign domain.
The subscription upgrade does not change the minimal-integration policy or the selected lead-transfer workflow.
The MeetAlfred plan change does not modify any HubSpot lead-management capability or data-organization requirement.
MeetAlfred subscription selection does not alter the campaign-domain warm-up obligation.
